title: 5 biggest mistakes beginners make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The number five is precise—it covers the most critical errors: overreliance, poor prompts, data bias, lack of validation, and ignoring ethics. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "Biggest" matters more. If a beginner misuses AI in healthcare or finance, the consequences are catastrophic, not just ranked fifth. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But without focusing on the top five, users miss structured learning. OpenAI's API documentation highlights these exact pitfalls as top concerns. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You can’t rank mistakes without knowing their impact. A single error in legal AI could lead to malpractice, not just a "biggest" list item. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Impact defines importance, not position on a list. (4 sec)
